title: epistel image manifest
description: Every vendored illustration file: its provenance, its place in the export, and every reference the edition makes to it. Vendor layer only (CC0); descriptions of our own would be an editorial layer. See docs/export-format.md.

id.description: The file's vendor-relative path, e.g. b1/ill_1.jpg. The join key: a captions dataset would key off this.

path.description: Where the file sits inside this export.

source.description: Upstream path and sha256 from the provenance record; with the manifest's pinned commit, a checkable address for the exact bytes.

figures.description: Every <figure> printing this file, in reading order. May be empty: some vendored files are referenced only from a page break, or not at all.

pageBreaks.description: Every <pb facs> reproducing a manuscript leaf with this file, in reading order. May be empty.

unshippedReferences.description: Image references in the vendored TEI that this export ships no file for: ded's own plates (ded is outside the corpus) and one reference dangling upstream. Listed rather than dropped; never repaired.

volume.description: The vendored directory the reference was written in.

letter.description: The letter the reference sits in, joining to letters/<volume>/<xmlId>.json; null where it sits in none (the commentary's plate sections, ded's dedications).

xmlId.description: The figure's xml:id, the edition's own.

type.description: TEI @type; only the two shared vignettes carry one.

url.description: The <graphic> url exactly as written, uppercase volume directories included.

head.description: The edition's caption lines, plain text, verbatim and complete (a second line usually holds the photo credit). Empty where the edition writes none.

figDesc.description: The figure's description; null where absent or left empty.

n.description: The leaf, in the manuscript's own numbering (1r, 2v).

edRef.description: The pagination series; absent on the manuscript's leaves, which is where facsimile references sit.
